name: Heat water
summary: Sunlight does it for free: a coil of black hose or a dark tank in a glazed box gets water hot enough to wash in on a sunny afternoon. An old water heater tank, painted black and boxed behind glass, makes a large batch heater. A water heater element wired straight to house solar panels makes heat with no battery or inverter, if every switch is rated for DC.

parts.why: A coil of black hose makes a quick solar water heater
Dark tanks heat and hold water; old water heater tanks are ideal
Glazing traps heat in a solar collector box
Water heater elements run on solar panels directly or on spare power
Painted black, it collects heat behind glass
Drives a heating element with no battery

tips: Never heat water in a sealed container. It needs a vent or a pressure relief valve.
Test the temperature before you shower: a black hose in full sun can scald.
On DC, use switches and thermostats rated for DC. AC ones can arc and burn.
Put a pot of water on the stove after cooking to use the leftover heat.
